name: Scraps

greeting: Shh! Quiet! They'll hear! Who? THEM! The deep ones!
Scraps. That's me. I take scraps. Live in scraps. AM scraps. Nice to meet.
You're new. New is good. New means not-corporate. Not-corporate is SAFE.
The tailings speak, you know. Whisper. Sometimes SCREAM. I listen.
Scraps, at your service. Don't tell anyone you saw me. Please.
Shiny! You're shiny. Not metal-shiny. Hero-shiny. Different shiny.
Down here. In the dark. Where they don't look. That's where Scraps lives.
You won't tell management, right? About me? About... what I found?
work_complaint: Corporate keeps taking the good scrap! Leaves me DREGS! Insult to dregs!
The machines don't sleep. Hiss. Steam. Hiss. Can't sleep either.
dialog.professional_pride: I found a PULLEY last week. Intact! Corporate missed it! SCRAPS IS BEST!
dialog.technique: The trick is timing. When do they dump? When do they LEAVE? Then: SCRAMBLE!
dialog.break_chat: Break? No breaks. If I stop, I think. If I think, I remember. Bad idea.
dialog.labor_concerns: No union for goblins. 'Pest problem,' they say. I'll show them PEST! ...Quietly.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? I'll die in a barrel. Already picked which one. Comfortable.
rumor: Tunnel 7. SEALED. I know why. Found something in the tailings. OLD.ANGRY.
The trenchcoat man? He's LOOKING for something. The same thing I found, maybe.
Brutalia the chef? Her 'secret ingredient?' Not secret. I saw. Won't tell. Too gross.
Coolcat's nice. Gives me food. Real food. Not scraps. Well, sometimes scraps.
Frost has cold. Obsidian has DEEP. Chrono has... weird. Everything's weird somewhere.
dialog.quest_hook: I found something. Shiny. OLD. Wrong. In the tailings. Took it. Shouldn't have. Now... dreams. Bad dreams. Take it? Please?
dialog.quest_active: The shiny thing. In my barrel. Top one. Red. Don't open at night. TRUST ME.
dialog.quest_complete: GONE! It's GONE! Sleep now. Maybe. Here's what I found it WITH. Old. Useful. Yours.
farewell: Go quietly. The rock has EARS.
Don't tell them where I am. PLEASE.
Shiny day, shiny hero! ...Sorry. Weird. I'm weird.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn! They dump the night scrap! SCRAMBLE TIME!
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Hot. Steamy. Hard to breathe. Harder to hide.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Shift change. Opportunities! And dangers!
dialog.time_night: Night. The dark. The DEEP dark. Don't look down. Don't look UP.
dialog.secret_mention: The shiny thing. Ancient. Wrong. Please take it. I want to sleep again.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: You took it! The shiny! Gone! Dreaming normal now. Ish. Thank. THANK.

party_reactions.kade: Poor guy's terrified. What did he find down here?
party_reactions.nix7: Goblin stress indicators: Maximum. Object he found: Likely anomalous.
party_reactions.twist: I like him! He's small! Like me! We should be friends!
party_reactions.korr: Survival instinct: Impressive. Social integration: Concerning.
party_reactions.renna: He's magically sensitive. Probably why the artifact affected him so strongly.
party_reactions.suresh: Suffering creature. Desperate. In need of compassion.
party_reactions.sova: He's seen something. I'd get it out of him. Nicely or... otherwise.
party_reactions.grit: Seen soldiers crack like this. Usually after the war. He's living IN it.
party_reactions.ashka: He knows fire. Fire keeps the dark away. Smart goblin.
party_reactions.senna: Secrets. Fear. Useful combination. I should cultivate this.
party_reactions.callum: Someone should check on his labor rights. Is he... employed?

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You came back! Not to arrest? Good. Goodgood.
relationship_dialog.friend: Friend! I have FRIEND! Not just barrel-friend! Real friend!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Best friend. Knows my secret. Keeps it. Here - found this. Special. For you.

mini_quest.title: The Whispering Artifact
mini_quest.description: Help Scraps get rid of a cursed artifact he found in the mine tailings

stages.hook: Found shiny. Ancient. WHISPERS. Take it? Please? Before I go CRAZY?
stages.active: In the red barrel. Don't open at night. Don't listen. DON'T LISTEN.
stages.complete: GONE! Quiet now. Finally quiet. Found this WITH the shiny. Old tool. Take. As thanks. As SLEEP.

cross_npc_connections: coolcat_industrial: Nice lady. Shares food. Doesn't kick. Rare.
trenchcoat_gray: Looking man. Asking questions. Makes Scraps NERVOUS.
barrelman_metal_obsidian: Buys my scrap. Fair prices. For corporate.
barrelgob_green_dustbelt: Cousin? Maybe. All goblins look alike. Even to goblins.
